key_insight: Peridynamic thermo-mechanical simulations identify cracking thresholds in tungsten under cyclic, fusion-relevant heat fluxes.
engineering_relevance: The approach could support screening plasma-facing materials and assessing heat-load limits for fusion-reactor armor.
method: Use CabanaPD for component-scale thermo-mechanical fracture simulations.
Model cyclic electron-beam exposure across base temperatures and heat fluxes.
Inform simulations with experimental data for recrystallized pure tungsten.
evidence_signal: Simulations compare well with experimental damage classifications from the JUDITH electron-beam facility, although the abstract reports no quantitative agreement metrics.
watch_item: Transfer to reactor service requires validation beyond electron-beam heating, including irradiation and particle-exposure effects.
paper_title: Peridynamic Thermo-Mechanical Modeling of Cracking in Tungsten under Fusion-Relevant Heat Fluxes
